summary: Completed full backend (pytest, 13/13 passing) and frontend (Playwright e2e) testing of TableTap Manager Dashboard. All requested features work as specified: numeric-only PIN with 10-digit cap, login flow, sidebar navigation, mark-not-available toggle reflecting on customer view via 1s auto-refresh, category add/remove (with case-insensitive duplicate rejection), menu CRUD, image upload validation, sales section with logout dialog (NO keeps session, YES clears mgr_token and routes to /login).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: /api/auth/login returns a token but no endpoint validates it; protected routes are unauthenticated. If multi-tenant or security matters, add auth middleware.

Backend: stats/today filters orders by `created_at` regex match on UTC date — clients in other timezones may see day boundaries off by hours; consider storing/filtering by local timezone or adding tz config.
Frontend: useInterval polling at 1s for /orders /menu /categories /stats simultaneously is bandwidth-heavy; consider WebSocket or longer interval with manual refresh button.
Frontend: window.confirm() used for category and item delete — not testable nor accessible; replace with shadcn AlertDialog like LogoutDialog.
Backend: image upload stores base64 directly in MongoDB documents; for many items this bloats DB and network. Consider object storage (S3) and store URL only.
seed_data_creation: Did not create new seed data. Created and cleaned up TEST_Pasta menu item, TEST Cat / QA Cat categories, TEST_QA_Dish item, and a transient test order (table 99). Test artifacts purged via cleanup curl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tabletap_api.py covers all CRUD + auth + image + stats. Frontend has all data-testid attributes (login-*, nav-*, menu-item-{id}, toggle-avail-{id}, cust-item-{id}, cust-na-{id}, cat-chip-{slug}, cat-remove-{slug}, sales-logout-btn, logout-yes-btn/no-btn). Auto-refresh is 1s, allow ~1.5s wait when verifying state changes.
